name: Fist Fight Arena
desc:
Welcome to Fist Fight Arena [FFA]

[🥊] Master your fighting skills!
[👊] Take down your opponents!
[🔥] Get KOs, build your streak, and dominate!
[👑] Fight your way to the top and claim the Crown!

👍 Enjoying the game? Leave a like and favorite to show your support!
🛠️ The game is currently in beta. Features may change, and bugs may occur.

⚠️ Exploiting or cheating will result in a permanent ban.

llm.loop: enter arena -> punch opponents -> get KOs and build streak -> claim the crown
llm.objectives: get KOs and keep a streak to hold the crown
llm.instructions: master fighting, take down opponents, build streaks
llm.thumbnails: first-person fist punch, red silhouette crater, grandma meme
